ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) base with a high density of high-intensity (white) point-source clusters. Macro-ratio estimated at approximately 15% white to 85% black across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High frequency of discrete, circular high-contrast white blobs (2-15 pixel diameter) distributed across both lobes. A concentration of larger, contiguous white intensity streaks is visible on the inner-lower quadrant of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped central depression with a calculated vertex angle of approximately 65 degrees and a vertical depth comprising roughly 12% of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serration pattern; continuous series of jagged peaks and valleys (5-20 pixel depth) spanning from the median notch to the distal tips on both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly concave trailing edge sweep with a sharp upward-tapering convex leading edge, terminating in acute, elongated tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Extensive, dense spatial clustering of roughly circular high-contrast white pixel groups (barnacle scars) covering approximately 70% of the visible surface area on both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A series of roughly parallel, vertical high-intensity linear marks (rake-like abrasions) located on the lower-inner region of the right lobe, adjacent to the water line.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive circular scarring (rosettes) across the entire visible surface; distinct vertical linear scarring on the lower right lobe; significant serrated erosion along the entire trailing edge boundary.
other_distinctive_markers: The density and uniformity of circular scarring across the dark background creates a unique high-frequency 'speckled' visual texture; exceptionally sharp and tapered distal tips.
